newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern, Canadian Pacific set pact.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern, Canadian Pacific set pact.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp and Canadian Pacific Ltd announced an agreement Wednesday in which the railroads will receive haulage rights on certain lines in an effort to enhance service and competition in key markets.

Under the agreement, Norfolk Southern will obtain rights to Canadian Pacific's access to New England through third party carrier Guilford Transportation. Norfolk Southern traffic now is carried on a line owned by Conrail Inc.
Norfolk Southern and CSX Corp have proposed a $10.3 billion offer to buy Conrail and split its assets. Under the deal, CSX would receive the Conrail line to New England.
The latest agreement also gives Canadian Pacific new access to markets in the U.S. Midwest via lines that Norfolk Southern will receive under the proposed Conrail transaction.
